bullets.text: Neos Networks Powers Edge Computing - **Neos Networks** partners with Cornerstone to enhance **StonesThro**'s distributed cloud infrastructure.
Vodafone Takes Full Control - **Vodafone** acquires CK Hutchison’s stake in **VodafoneThree** for £4.3 billion, simplifying operations.
FIG Cable Enhances Connectivity - **Ooredoo** and **du** launch the largest subsea cable in the GCC, boosting regional data flows.
